facts.name: Sandra C. Upchurch
facts.assignment: Division49 Flagler circuit civil; also Division53 Putnam circuit civil. This review applies Division49 instructions only.

contact.contact_note: Division49 mailbox receives hearing materials and courtesy hearing notices; scheduling/office email uses assistant. Shared office telephone; personal judicial email not established.

hearing_scheduling.summary: Request times from assistant, copying parties, then coordinate and obtain confirmation. File notice within three days of confirmation; email courtesy notice to Division49 mailbox. Cross-noticing requires court permission and party agreement.

conferral.summary: Procedures require Rule1.202 compliance and three attempts including telephone communication, documented in motion when unsuccessful.

proposed_orders.summary: Circulate among parties, then e-file into existing case; ordinarily within seven days after hearing unless directed otherwise. Competing orders not accepted: email assistant for hearing on impasse. Consult official document for formatting and exceptions.

courtesy_copies.summary: Email hearing materials/case law to Division49@circuit7.org; page9 states NO earlier/later than48Hours before hearing and rejects paper copies. Identify hearing date/time/duration and case in subject; wording preserved literally.

remote_appearances.summary: Page3 describes remote non-evidentiary or under60-minute hearings, but separately requires in-person nonjury trials, evidentiary hearings and60-minute-or-longer hearings unless agreed and approved. Confirm format where provisions overlap; requests to attend a designated remote hearing in person require five days notice.

chambers_communications.summary: Email assistant with county, case number/name and relevant matter; copy parties. Do not copy assistant on interparty messages requiring no chambers action. Telephone only if excused from email service.

facts.summary: Assistant-coordinated circuit civil hearings; existing-case e-portal orders; dedicated Division49 hearing-materials mailbox. County-specific and remote-format qualifications retained.

review_scope.collected: Official profile HTML and full nine-page Division49 procedures PDF.
review_scope.content_reviewed: Profile contacts/assignments; PDF pages1–5 office communications, scheduling, conferral, appearance and general proposed-order operations; page9 hearing-materials channel/timing.
review_scope.not_reviewed: Detailed discovery, foreclosure, trial/exhibit and other motion-specific litigation requirements. Putnam procedures and linked trial/notice forms retained as links only.

conflicts.statement: Page3 sectionIII.A uses non-evidentiary matters OR hearings under60minutes for remote proceedings; III.B requires in-person evidentiary and60-minute-or-longer hearings unless agreed/approved. Preserve both; do not infer rule for overlapping categories.

gaps: Personal judicial email and separate assistant-only telephone not established.

citations.name: practices
citations.locator: Pages1–5 general office operations and page9 hearing-materials instructions; detailed litigation sections collected only
